layer1.name: PostPilot
layer1.one_liner: AI that drafts weekly LinkedIn posts for B2B founders.
layer1.description: A tool that ingests a founder's product notes and drafts five LinkedIn posts a week in their voice, with a scheduling calendar. Positioned at $29/month against manual drafting.
layer1.outcome_note: Synthetic fixture. Not a real company and not counted toward separation statistics.

layer2.pins: The headline behaviour: thorough desk research, zero primary conversations. Evidence Quality is 0, so the cap sits at 30 and binds — the weighted mean lands around 36 and the composite is held to 30. Note the cap is a ceiling, not a floor: a weaker ledger than this one scores below 30, which composite.test.ts pins directly.

assumptions.statement: B2B founders who post weekly on LinkedIn spend more than 3 hours a week drafting posts

falsification_criterion.applies_to: B2B software founders posting to LinkedIn at least weekly
falsification_criterion.observation: ask them to walk through their last four posts and time each one
falsification_criterion.metric: count who spent 3+ hours per week drafting

assumptions.statement: No incumbent social scheduling tool ships built-in AI post drafting within 12 months of launch

falsification_criterion.applies_to: the top 5 social scheduling tools by market share
falsification_criterion.observation: check each product's changelog and pricing page for AI drafting
falsification_criterion.metric: count of incumbents shipping AI drafting

assumptions.statement: At least 4 in 10 target founders already pay for a standalone drafting tool, unbundled from scheduling

falsification_criterion.applies_to: B2B software founders posting to LinkedIn at least weekly
falsification_criterion.observation: ask what they currently pay for content tooling and what they cancelled
falsification_criterion.metric: count who currently pay for a drafting-only tool

assumptions.statement: LinkedIn organic posting reaches at least 30 qualified founders per week at zero paid cost

falsification_criterion.applies_to: a new account posting daily for four weeks
falsification_criterion.observation: measure qualified profile views per week from organic posts
